description: Update a task. Give only the fields to change; assignedTo, tags and links replace the existing lists. Archive with status "archived".

agentName.description: Your agent name, shown as the creator, e.g. "Kampagnen-Agent Die Kette"; without it the item is still marked as agent-created

assignedTo.description: User ids (list_users, get_my_colleagues, get_my_profile) or team member ids (list_project_members); user ids are mapped to the team member

deadline.description: Start and due date of the task

linkedIssue.description: Key or URL of the issue in an external tracker, e.g. DWP-6540

links.description: Links shown on the task, e.g. the PR, the Figma frame or the prototype screen

title.description: Label shown instead of the URL

parentTaskId.description: Mongo id of the parent task; makes this a subtask

status.description: open | in_progress | in_review | needs_rework | done | archived

taskId.description: Task Mongo id or task number such as ZERO-41

updates.description: Legacy: JSON object of fields; typed fields win

name: update_task
title: Update task
